headword: {臨時休業|りんじきゅうぎょう}

definitions.explanation: A business, shop, or facility closing temporarily outside of its regular closing days. May be due to owner illness, maintenance, weather, or special circumstances.

examples.japanese: {本日|ほんじつ}は{臨時休業|りんじきゅうぎょう}です。
{台風|たいふう}のため{臨時休業|りんじきゅうぎょう}いたします。
examples.english: We will be temporarily closed due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {行|い}きつけのカフェが{臨時休業|りんじきゅうぎょう}だったので、{仕方|しかた}なく{別|べつ}の{店|みせ}に{入|はい}った。
examples.english: My usual café was temporarily closed, so I reluctantly went to a different shop.

notes:
USAGE:
Often seen on signs posted on shop doors or announced on social media and websites. A common sight in Japan, especially during typhoons, public health emergencies, or when an owner-operated shop needs a day off.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {臨時休業|りんじきゅうぎょう}のお{知|し}らせ (notice of temporary closure)
- {臨時休業|りんじきゅうぎょう}いたします (we will be temporarily closed — polite)
- {臨時休業|りんじきゅうぎょう}{日|び} (day of temporary closure)
